items.title: 1.2 Predicting a Quadratic Function from its Graph (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Book p. 3-4: 1.2 factor form from x-intercepts and a third point, Example 3 (Figure 1.5) and Example 4

blocks.text: Pichle sabaq mein humare paas function tha aur hum ne us ka graph banaya. Aaj ulta kaam karenge: graph (ya graph ki kuch maloomaat) di hogi, aur humein function dhoondna hai. Yeh bilkul aisa hai jaise kisi ke qadmon ke nishaan dekh kar andaza lagana ke kaun guzra; graph ke kuch khaas points se poora function pehchana ja sakta hai. Exam mein aise sawal aksar aate hain, aur in ka tareeqa chhota aur pakka hai, is liye ise achhi tarah samajh lijiye.
Kitab kehti hai: agar x-intercepts aur curve par ek aur point maloom ho, to quadratic function \(f(x) = ax^{2} + bx + c\) ko us ke graph se factor form ki madad se maloom kiya ja sakta hai.
Agar graph x-axis ko \(x = h\) aur \(x = k\) par kaatta hai, to function yun likha ja sakta hai:

blocks.text_alt: f of x equals a times (x minus h) times (x minus k)

blocks.text: Yahan \(a\) ek constant hai jo parabola ki shakal (kitna tang ya khula) aur direction (upar ya neeche) tay karta hai. \(a\) nikalne ke liye kisi teesre maloom point ke coordinates equation mein rakh dein.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Yeh 1.1 ka ulta hai. 1.1 mein function se intercepts nikale the; ab intercepts se function banana hai.
Teesra point kyun zaroori hai? Intercepts sirf factors batate hain. \(y = (x - 1)(x - 2)\), \(y = 5(x - 1)(x - 2)\) aur \(y = -3(x - 1)(x - 2)\), teeno x-axis ko 1 aur 2 par hi kaatte hain. Farq sirf \(a\) ka hai: koi zyada steep (tez dhalwan wala), koi ulta. Graph par ek aur point mil jaye to in sab mein se sirf ek sahi \(a\) bachta hai.
Aur agar graph x-axis ko \(x = h\) par sirf chhoota ho, to factor repeated hai: \(y = a(x - h)^{2}\) lein (1.1 ka Case-II), aur phir ek aur point se \(a\) nikal lein.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Maan lijiye kisi ne aap ko sirf itna bataya ke graph x-axis ko 1 aur 2 par kaatta hai. Kya aap function bata sakte hain? Nahi, kyun ke \(a\) ki koi bhi value chal sakti hai. Isi liye sawal hamesha ek aur point deta hai. Aur dhyan rahe: woh point x-axis se bahar ka hona chahiye, warna \(0 = 0\) aayega aur \(a\) nahi milega.

Ab kitab ki do misalein dekhte hain. Pehli mein graph diya hai, doosri mein sirf maloomaat. Dono mein teen qadam hain: factor form likhna, teesre point se a nikalna, aur wapas rakh kar simplify karna.

blocks.alt: Grid graph of a downward parabola cutting the x-axis at (minus 1, 0) and (1, 0) and reaching its highest point (0, 4) on the y-axis. The curve is y = minus 4x squared plus 4.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.5: the graph given in Example 3 (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.title: Example 3
blocks.problem: Find the function whose graph is shown in Figure 1.5.
steps:
Diya gaya: Figure 1.5 ka graph x-axis ko \((-1, 0)\) aur \((1, 0)\) par kaatta hai aur \((0, 4)\) se guzarta hai.
Maloom karna: is graph ka quadratic function.
Tareeqa: factor form \(f(x) = a(x - h)(x - k)\). Do x-intercepts se \(h\) aur \(k\) milenge, aur teesre point se \(a\). Yahi tareeqa is liye theek hai ke graph mein intercepts saaf nazar aa rahe hain.

Step 1: factor form likhein
Figure se \(h = -1\) aur \(k = 1\).
\[y = a(x - (-1))(x - 1)\]
\[y = a(x + 1)(x - 1) \quad \text{...(1)}\]
Kyun: har x-intercept \(x = h\) ek factor \((x - h)\) deta hai. \(h = -1\) ke liye \((x - (-1)) = (x + 1)\) banta hai.
Dhyan dein: yahan sab se zyada ghalti hoti hai; \(-1\) wala root \((x + 1)\) deta hai, \((x - 1)\) nahi.

Step 2: point \((0, 4)\) se \(a\) nikalein
\[4 = a(0 + 1)(0 - 1)\]
\[4 = -a\]
\[a = -4\]
Kyun: \((0, 4)\) curve par hai, to us ke coordinates equation (1) ko satisfy karte hain. Sirf intercepts se \(a\) maloom nahi hota, kyun ke har \(a(x+1)(x-1)\) ke intercepts yahi hain; teesra point sahi \(a\) chunta hai.

Step 3: wapas rakh kar simplify karein
\[y = -4(x + 1)(x - 1)\]
\[= -4(x^{2} - 1)\]
\[y = -4x^{2} + 4\]
Kyun: \((x + 1)(x - 1) = x^{2} - 1\), yeh difference of squares ka formula hai: \((p + q)(p - q) = p^{2} - q^{2}\).

Tasdeeq:
\[y(-1) = -4(1) + 4 = 0 \;\checkmark\]
\[y(1) = -4(1) + 4 = 0 \;\checkmark\]
\[y(0) = 4 \;\checkmark\]
Aur \(a = -4 < 0\), yani graph neeche ki taraf khulta hai, bilkul figure ki tarah. Teeno points aur direction match ho gaye.

blocks.title: Example 4
blocks.problem: Find an equation of the graph whose x-intercepts are \(x = 1\) and \(x = 2\) and passes through the point \((3, 4)\).
steps:
Diya gaya: x-intercepts \(x = 1\) aur \(x = 2\); point \((3, 4)\) graph par hai.
Maloom karna: graph (parabola) ki equation.
Tareeqa: factor form \(y = a(x - h)(x - k)\), jahan \(h = 1\), \(k = 2\). Phir \((3, 4)\) rakh kar \(a\) nikalenge. Is dafa graph nahi diya, sirf maloomaat di hain, lekin tareeqa bilkul wohi hai.

Step 1: factor form
\[y = a(x - 1)(x - 2) \quad \text{...(1)}\]
Kyun: x-intercepts 1 aur 2 se factors \((x - 1)\) aur \((x - 2)\) bante hain.

Step 2: \((3, 4)\) se \(a\) nikalein
\[4 = a(3 - 1)(3 - 2) = 2a\]
\[a = \dfrac{4}{2} = 2\]
Kyun: point graph par hai, is liye \(x = 3\), \(y = 4\) equation (1) mein poore utarte hain. Ab sirf \(a\) unknown bacha, jo seedha nikal aaya.

Step 3: wapas rakh kar expand karein
\[y = 2(x - 1)(x - 2)\]
\[= 2(x^{2} - 3x + 2)\]
\[y = 2x^{2} - 6x + 4\]
Kyun: \((x - 1)(x - 2) = x^{2} - 2x - x + 2 = x^{2} - 3x + 2\); phir har term ko 2 se zarb diya.

Tasdeeq:
\[y(1) = 2 - 6 + 4 = 0 \;\checkmark\]
\[y(2) = 8 - 12 + 4 = 0 \;\checkmark\]
\[y(3) = 18 - 18 + 4 = 4 \;\checkmark\]
Teeno di hui shartein poori ho gayin, is liye jawab sahi hai.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text: Misaal (hamari taraf se): graph x-axis ko \(x = 3\) par sirf chhoota hai aur \((1, 8)\) se guzarta hai. Chhoota hai, is liye \(y = a(x - 3)^{2}\). Point rakhein: \(8 = a(1 - 3)^{2} = 4a\), to \(a = 2\). Jawab: \(y = 2(x - 3)^{2} = 2x^{2} - 12x + 18\). Tasdeeq: \(x = 1\) par \(2(4) = 8\) \(\checkmark\).

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Intercepts \(x = h\), \(x = k\) se \(y = a(x - h)(x - k)\) likhein.
2. Graph x-axis ko \(x = h\) par sirf chhoota ho to \(y = a(x - h)^{2}\).
3. \(a\) nikalne ke liye graph ka ek aur point \((x_{1}, y_{1})\) rakhein, jo x-axis par na ho.
4. \(a\) ka sign tasveer se match hona chahiye: \(a > 0\) to upar khulta, \(a < 0\) to neeche.
5. Aakhir mein jawab ko har diye hue point par check karein.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. \(x = -1\) ka factor \((x - 1)\) likh dena. Sahi factor \((x - (-1)) = (x + 1)\) hai.
2. \(a\) bhool kar sirf \(y = (x - h)(x - k)\) likh dena.
3. \(a\) nikalne ke liye x-intercept hi rakh dena: \(0 = 0\) aata hai, kuch maloom nahi hota.
4. \(a\) solve karte waqt sign ki ghalti: \(4 = -a\) se \(a = -4\) aata hai, \(4\) nahi.
5. Jawab expand kar ke check na karna; aik minute ki tasdeeq poore marks bacha leti hai.
